backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping helix‑motion related features to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing major frontend components, styles, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base styles defining theme variables and dark‑mode overrides for layout and colors.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component wrapping StartDashboard with theme and toast providers.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Factor: Interactive factor card with icon, description, and helix connection line supporting selection and accessibility states.
frontend/src/components/genome/HelixSpin: Renders animated DNA helix SVG strands and base pairs with reduced‑motion handling and a container for factor markers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and updates an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and invalidates dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provider and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, identity state, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder for future backend‑related React Query hooks.
frontend/src/index.css: Global genome‑themed styling with scientific color palette, typography, and helix utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility function cn() merging class names with clsx and tailwind‑merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app, sets up React Query client and wraps App in InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/StartDashboard.tsx: Renders the longevity dashboard with a DNA-helix layout and interactive factor markers for nutrition, sleep, movement, and fasting.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugin usage for the genome‑styled UI.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature list, and architectural notes describing the genome‑themed LivSpan dashboard.
